name: devpilot-ai
description: DevPilot AI convierte una tarea o un bug descrito en lenguaje natural en una especificación técnica lista para implementar.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @devpilot/shared && npm run dev -w @devpilot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @devpilot/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @devpilot/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @devpilot/shared && npm run test:integration -w @devpilot/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devpilot/shared && npm run build -w @devpilot/api && npm run build -w @devpilot/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @devpilot/shared && npm run db:seed -w @devpilot/api
